summary: Phase 1 - Recovery state & execution safety (backend, in-memory simulation). Verified the audit's R1-R4 against the code (reproduced: 40 executions of one item gave 19 'recoveries'; shared idempotency key returned another transaction's result; 66/100 transaction ids differ in amount across scans). Added scan runs (identical source data re-activates its run; new data supersedes, never deletes), RecoveryCase with an enforced state machine, an ExecutionAttempt ledger, execution-time strict (fail-closed) policy re-evaluation from that ledger, merchant+operation-scoped idempotency bound to a request fingerprint, an atomic() repository section with reserve-then-call-provider-then-complete, bulk /recover through the same pathway, and run-scoped analytics/audit. New: services/execution_service.py, docs/RECOVERY_LIFECYCLE.md. Policy: subscription rule now precedes the cooldown rules; new hours_since_last_attempt cooldown input. 172 backend tests pass (25 pre-existing; one test helper adjusted, assertions unchanged); mutation checks confirm tests fail when each safeguard is removed. Frontend: optional type fields only; tsc and an isolated production build pass; UI NOT browser-verified. Limits: in-memory only, single-process locking, simulated provider, no auth/tenancy, not production-ready. PENDING GEMINI REVIEW. Backups + RESTORE.md: backend/_backups/recovery-lifecycle-phase1-20261014/ and frontend/_backups/recovery-lifecycle-phase1-preview-20261014/.
